title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics helpers + slo-toolkit integration
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: improve incident-bot's oncall autodiagnostics by extracting reusable helper utilities and integrating with the slo-toolkit context enrichment APIs. The goal is to make runbook linking and SLO correlation faster and more reliable in noisy incidents, and reduce duplicate logic spread across incident-bot and slo-toolkit.

What this PR does: - Adds a new incident_bot/autodiag/helpers module with utilities for extracting SLO context from alerts, normalizing runbook links, and generating compact diagnostic summaries. - Introduces a thin integration layer incident_bot/slo_integration that calls slo-toolkit's context enrichment endpoints and falls back to local heuristics when the toolkit is unavailable. - Updates the oncall command handlers to call the new helpers and include SLO hints & runbook quicklinks in the oncall summary payload. - Adds unit and integration tests covering edge cases (missing slo metadata, partial runbook matches). - Updates docs with a short how-to for enabling the integration and toggling heuristic fallback.

Checklist: - [x] extract helpers into reusable module - [x] add integration adapter to slo-toolkit - [x] unit tests for helpers - [x] integration tests for API failure/fallback - [x] docs and console examples - [x] change log entry

Compatibility and rollout: The integration is opt-in via INCIDENT_BOT_ENABLE_SLO_TOOLKIT env var. When enabled, calls to slo-toolkit are rate-limited and guarded; if the toolkit returns 5xx or times out, the incident-bot falls back to local heuristics and records the failure metric incident_bot.slo_integration.failures. No breaking changes to the incident-bot public commands.

Testing: added pytest unit tests for helpers and a small integration test that runs a mocked slo-toolkit server to verify the fallback path. Ran full CI and fixed two flaky tests (timing-based) by switching to deterministic time mocking.

Release notes: Adds oncall autodiagnostics helpers and optional slo-toolkit integration to provide richer runbook quicklinks and SLO hints in oncall summaries.
